description: This file defines the PresignUrlMiddleware class in the AWS SDK for PHP, responsible for adding pre-signed URLs to service commands that require them, particularly for operations needing temporary access URLs.

classes.name: PresignUrlMiddleware
classes.description: A middleware class that adds presigned URLs to AWS service operation commands to facilitate temporary access, used internally within the AWS SDK.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the middleware with configuration options, including operations requiring presign URLs and client details.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: A static method that wraps a given AWS client with this middleware, returning a callable handler.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: The main callable method executed during request handling, which adds a presigned URL to commands that need it.

methods.name: createPresignedUrl
methods.description: Generates a presigned URL for the specified AWS command, resolving the appropriate endpoint and signing the request.
